brief:
Britain has renamed its consulate in Jerusalem to "the UK Mission," the Ma'an news agency reported. The move reflects a shift in how the British government designates its presence in the city, though specifics of the operational changes remain unclear.

The renaming comes as Britain continues its work in Jerusalem. The designation change alters the official title under which Britain conducts diplomatic activities in the contested city.
title: Britain renames Jerusalem consulate to UK mission amid operational shift
